pages.text: Heavy rain fell from evening onward. The rising river roared loudly. Rush, rush, rush.
Earlier, the children had promised to see the new water's edge the next morning. Mina slapped their palms together.
Raju asked, "Aren't you scared of the water's sound?" Mina answered, "I'm not scared."
The light went out. The water sounded louder. Mina pulled the quilt over their nose.
Raju slept soundly. Sonu slept close beside Mom. Only Mina lay awake in the middle.
The window grew pale. Mina had not slept a wink all night.
Morning came. The two quilts beside Mina were empty. Mina still blinked beneath their own.
Mom touched Mina's forehead. "Wake me when you're scared."
That night, Mina shook Mom. "The water's sound scares me." Mom lay beside Mina.
The next morning, the rain stopped. Mina got up first. Mom and the three children walked along the dry path, looking at the water's edge far below.
